There is no truth coming
Other than the truth that's here.
I wish we were more forthcoming
About the beauty our hearts want and revere
And hold so dear without question,
I wish our knowledge of the good
Would bloom beyond the buds mere suggestion.
There is no truth coming
Because truth arrives
In the immediacy of your knowing
Before the times contrive
To swallow life in the flowing,
And yet... life abides, even as it sinks.
I'll close my eyes only to blink as I gladly receive
The plight of this world seeming severed without reprieve
And being true in these times amounts to knowing
that we collectively conspire in the severance we breathe
As children on the threshold of nightmares and dreams.
We are the fated tightrope walker, a suspended sign
This anthropic flight, treacherous and sublime
We walk the line, between and beyond
The laws of fissure and fragment, gravity and bond.
